editorial:
Imagine taking your teenage daughter to a huge pop concert, only to realize the whole event is a trap designed to catch a serial killer. That is the wild setup of Trap, a thriller that puts you right in the middle of a father's desperate attempt to keep his dark secret hidden while keeping his daughter safe. Josh Hartnett plays the dad, and he brings a creepy, charming energy that keeps you guessing the whole time. The concert setting feels loud and alive, and the tension builds as the walls close in around him. You will feel the pressure of every close call and every suspicious glance from the crowd.

The movie moves fast and keeps you on your toes, though some twists might feel a bit silly if you think too hard about them. Hartnett's performance is the real highlight, and the concert scenes are fun and energetic. If you enjoy thrillers with a big twist and do not mind a few plot holes, this one is for you.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn that the father, Cooper, is actually the serial killer known as The Butcher. The entire concert was an FBI sting operation set up to catch him. After a tense chase through the venue, Cooper manages to escape with his daughter, but the police are still on his trail. The twist ending reveals that his daughter may have figured out his secret, leaving you wondering if she will turn him in or protect him. It ends on an unsettling note that keeps you thinking.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves thrillers with big twists and concert settings.
